d:
The MEANS hypnosis app becomes the focus of yet another of my adult stories. But this time with a twist:

The "Loser Shounen Lead" succeeds in getting his revenge using that app. However, his victory's short-lived.

The academy he's going to is being run by a villainess (ala Discipline). And she forces him to become a tennis player for the team she's also in (ala Softenni and Teekyuu).

What will happen to our anti-hero? To the team he's now in? To his victim?
